mapper.sql: SELECT t.*, COALESCE(c.code, s.code) AS partner_code, COALESCE(c.name, s.name) AS partner_name, h.nickname AS handler_name, cu.nickname AS create_by_name, ru.nickname AS review_by_name, a.name AS account_name, b.bill_no, b.settled_amount AS bill_settled_amount, b.voucher_id, v.voucher_no, v.status AS voucher_status FROM fin_offset t LEFT JOIN scm_customer c ON t.kind = 'AR' AND c.id = t.partner_id LEFT JOIN scm_supplier s ON t.kind = 'AP' AND s.id = t.partner_id LEFT JOIN sys_user h ON h.id = t.handler_id LEFT JOIN sys_user cu ON cu.id = t.create_by LEFT JOIN sys_user ru ON ru.id = t.review_by LEFT JOIN fin_account a ON a.id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN fin_bill b ON b.id = t.bill_id LEFT JOIN fin_voucher v ON v.id = b.voucher_id
